# Medcity Overseas (Medcity Study Abroad)

> Medcity International Overseas Corporation is a study-abroad consultancy headquartered in Kannur, Kerala, India, operating since 2012 under the Medcity Study Abroad / Medcity Overseas brand. It helps students plan and complete international education journeys - from university and course selection through admissions, visas, and pre-departure support - across Germany, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, and other destinations.

## About

- Founded in 2012 (12+ years of operation).
- 18+ branches across Kerala, India.
- Reports guiding 185,000+ students to date, with 1,500+ partner universities across 50+ countries served.
- Chairman: Rahul Chakrapani.
- Mission: to make the study-abroad journey simple, transparent, and student-focused through dependable support at every stage.
- Vision: a future where every student can confidently access reliable guidance, quality education, and meaningful global opportunities.
- Core values: integrity, excellence, student success, innovation, and trust.

## Services

- University and course selection counselling, based on academic profile, budget, and career goals
- University application support and admission documentation
- Language preparation
- Student visa guidance and documentation support
- Scholarship and financial aid guidance
- Education loan assistance
- Pre-departure planning and support (accommodation, travel, banking)
- Migration-related guidance

## Study destinations

Germany, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, and other international destinations. Dedicated guidance is offered for German study pathways, including language training.

## Who we help

Plus Two (pre-university) students, undergraduate and postgraduate applicants, and students pursuing MBBS or PhD programmes abroad.
